## Change

Explain the problem, resulting behavior, and phase/review step.

## Validation

List checks run and results. Explain checks not run.

## Review

- [ ] Behavior and domain language match agreed requirements.
- [ ] Dependency direction and affected ADRs are correct.
- [ ] Public XML documentation is accurate (or no public API changed).
- [ ] Relevant tests and CI pass; missing tests are explained.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive example values are included.
- [ ] Explicit phase approval is recorded before merging.
